_notes: Single source of truth for the featured map pins. Used by the frontend map (via /api/locations/),
the Location model seed, tools/snapshot_power.py and the prepulled data folders (folder name = slug).
To move a pin: change lat/lon here, re-run tools/snapshot_power.py, and request new AppEEARS data for it.
status 'provisional' = the point is not confirmed as cropland yet (see 'why' and 'candidates').

locations.name: Sindh (Hyderabad area)
locations.why: MODIS NDVI 2006-2025 is flat (0.23-0.32): town edge or bare land. Candidates checked 2026-11-15 (25.45,68.60 always green; 25.25,68.50 bare; 25.70,68.50 mixed) are not cropland either. Kept here with SMAP only (9 km cell covers the surrounding farmland); NDVI not used.

locations.name: Punjab (Faisalabad area)
locations.why: Moved from 31.4, 73.1 (city: no soil data, NDVI 0.13-0.19). Rural point: MODIS NDVI 0.30-0.63 with crop seasons (some mixing), SoilGrids silt loam. NDVI + SMAP pre-pulled for this point.

locations.name: Central Iowa (near Ames)
locations.why: Moved from 42.0, -93.6 (NDVI 0.33-0.63, mixed with the town of Ames). New point: MODIS NDVI 0.01-0.89, strong corn/soy seasons. SMAP still needs a new AppEEARS request for this point (old SMAP was ~15 km away, not used).
